item.title: PH has crude oil up to June 30 — PBBM | BusinessChannel.ph
item.description: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. said the country’s current inventory of crude oil is enough to keep supplies steady through June 30, as government agencies continue looking for additional sources amid heightened global tensions affecting energy markets.
